name: AlertDialog
description:
A dialog that demands a response - a destructive or high-stakes confirmation.

  AlertDialog do
    AlertDialogTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :destructive) { "Delete project" } }
    AlertDialogContent do
      AlertDialogHeader do
        AlertDialogTitle { "Delete this project?" }
        AlertDialogDescription { "This can't be undone." }
      end
      AlertDialogFooter do
        AlertDialogClose { |close| Button(**close, variant: :outline) { "Cancel" } }
        button_to("Delete", project_path(@project), method: :delete, class: …)
      end
    end
  end

Dialog's parts under AlertDialog names, with `role="alertdialog"`, no corner close button and no dismissal by clicking outside - the user has to choose (Escape still cancels).
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `AlertDialog(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

AlertDialogContent.description: The alert dialog's card: narrower than a Dialog and without a corner close button.

AlertDialogTitle.description: The <h2> that labels the alert dialog.

examples.name: Destructive confirmation
examples.notes:
The confirm button uses the destructive variant; cancel comes first. Clicking outside doesn't
close it - Escape or a button does.

examples.name: With media
examples.notes: An icon above a centered header, with full-width actions.

examples.name: Asynchronous action
examples.notes:
Keep it open while the request runs: the confirm button shows a spinner and the dialog
closes itself when done (here after a fake delay; in an app, a Turbo Stream response).

examples.name: RTL
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl") do
    AlertDialog do
      AlertDialogTrigger { |trigger| Button(**trigger, variant: :destructive) { "حذف المشروع" } }
      AlertDialogContent do
        AlertDialogHeader do
          AlertDialogTitle { "حذف هذا المشروع؟" }
          AlertDialogDescription { "سيتم حذف المشروع وجميع ملفاته نهائيًا. لا يمكن التراجع عن ذلك." }
        end
        AlertDialogFooter do
          AlertDialogClose { |close| Button(**close, variant: :outline) { "إلغاء" } }
          AlertDialogClose { |close| Button(**close, variant: :destructive) { "حذف" } }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
